subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you recommend something typical from this region?
portuguese: Podia recomendar-me algo típico desta região?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah reh-koh-men-DAR-mih AL-goo TEE-pee-koo DESH-tah reh-zhee-AWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: Gostava de provar algo típico desta região.
exampleSentences.english: I would like to try something typical from this region.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Do you have anything less heavy?
portuguese: Tem alguma coisa menos pesada?
notes: Useful when a menu feels too rich.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ao jantar, prefiro uma opção menos pesada.
exampleSentences.english: For dinner, I prefer a less heavy option.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you bring the starters first and the mains later?
portuguese: Podia trazer primeiro as entradas e depois os pratos principais?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Preferíamos que os pratos viessem mais tarde.
exampleSentences.english: We would prefer the dishes to come later.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We are still deciding.
portuguese: Ainda estamos a decidir.
notes: Useful when staff check in before you are ready.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda estamos a decidir, pode voltar daqui a pouco?
exampleSentences.english: We are still deciding, can you come back in a bit?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could we have a few more minutes?
portuguese: Podia dar-nos mais uns minutos?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda estamos a ver a ementa, podia dar-nos mais uns minutos?
exampleSentences.english: We are still looking at the menu, could you give us a few more minutes?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I am lactose intolerant.
portuguese: Sou intolerante à lactose.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sou intolerante à lactose, por isso preciso de confirmar os ingredientes.
exampleSentences.english: I am lactose intolerant, so I need to confirm the ingredients.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you tell me what this dish contains?
portuguese: Podia dizer-me o que leva este prato?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah dee-ZAIR-m oo kuh LEH-vah ESH-t prah-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podia dizer-me se este prato leva marisco?
exampleSentences.english: Could you tell me if this dish contains seafood?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Does this sauce contain wine?
portuguese: Este molho leva vinho?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Queria saber se este molho leva alho.
exampleSentences.english: I wanted to know if this sauce contains garlic.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could it be made without cheese?
portuguese: Podia ser feito sem queijo?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Este prato podia ser feito sem queijo?
exampleSentences.english: Could this dish be made without cheese?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I would prefer something traditional rather than touristy.
portuguese: Preferia uma coisa tradicional em vez de algo muito turístico.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Queríamos um sítio mais tradicional.
exampleSentences.english: We wanted a more traditional place.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Is this dish usually very spicy?
portuguese: Este prato costuma ser muito picante?
pronunciationNote: ESH-t prah-too koosh-TOO-mah sair MWEEN-too pee-KAHN-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não me importo com picante, mas queria saber se é muito forte.
exampleSentences.english: I do not mind spice, but I wanted to know if it is very strong.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Would it be possible to share this dish?
portuguese: Seria possível partilhar este prato?
notes: Useful for tapas-style or large portions.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Acha que este prato dá para partilhar?
exampleSentences.english: Do you think this dish is enough to share?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Do you serve food all afternoon?
portuguese: Servem comida durante toda a tarde?
pronunciationNote: SAIR-veng koh-MEE-dah doo-RAN-t TOH-dah ah TAR-d

exampleSentences.portuguese: A cozinha está aberta durante toda a tarde?
exampleSentences.english: Is the kitchen open all afternoon?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: What time does the kitchen close?
portuguese: A que horas fecha a cozinha?
pronunciationNote: ah kuh OR-ash FEH-zhah ah koo-ZEE-nyah
notes: Important in Portugal where kitchens may close between services.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se chegarmos tarde, ainda servem jantar?
exampleSentences.english: If we arrive late, do you still serve dinner?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We have a reservation under the name Silva.
portuguese: Temos uma reserva em nome de Silva.
pronunciationNote: TEH-moosh OO-mah reh-ZAIR-vah ayn NOH-m dih SEEL-vah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Temos uma reserva para duas pessoas.
exampleSentences.english: We have a reservation for two people.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could we move to another table?
portuguese: Podíamos mudar para outra mesa?
notes: Useful if the table is uncomfortable.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podíamos ficar numa mesa mais calma?
exampleSentences.english: Could we sit at a quieter table?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: This table is a bit too noisy for conversation.
portuguese: Esta mesa é um pouco barulhenta para conversar.
pronunciationNote: ESH-tah MEH-zah eh oom POH-koo bah-roo-LYEN-tah
notes: Natural reason for asking to move.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Lá fora está mais calmo para conversar.
exampleSentences.english: It is calmer outside for talking.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you bring an extra plate for sharing?
portuguese: Podia trazer um prato extra para partilhar?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Pode trazer talheres extra também?
exampleSentences.english: Could you bring extra cutlery as well?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could we have separate bills?
portuguese: Podíamos pagar em separado?

exampleSentences.portuguese: É possível dividir a conta?
exampleSentences.english: Is it possible to split the bill?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I think there is a mistake on the bill.
portuguese: Penso que há um erro na conta.
pronunciationNote: PEN-soo keh ah oom EH-hoo nah KON-tah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Penso que esta bebida foi cobrada duas vezes.
exampleSentences.english: I think this drink was charged twice.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We did not order this.
portuguese: Nós não pedimos isto.
notes: Useful when the wrong item arrives.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, nós não pedimos esta entrada.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, we did not order this starter.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I am sorry, but this is not what I asked for.
portuguese: Desculpe, mas isto não foi o que pedi.
pronunciationNote: desh-KOOL-p mas EESH-too nawng foy oo kuh peh-DEE

exampleSentences.portuguese: Pedi o peixe, não o frango.
exampleSentences.english: I asked for the fish, not the chicken.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Would it be possible to replace this side dish?
portuguese: Seria possível trocar este acompanhamento?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Seria possível trocar as batatas por legumes?
exampleSentences.english: Would it be possible to replace the potatoes with vegetables?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you leave the sauce on the side?
portuguese: Podia deixar o molho à parte?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah day-SHAR oo MOL-yoo ah PAR-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podia trazer o molho à parte, por favor?
exampleSentences.english: Could you bring the sauce on the side, please?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I am trying to avoid fried food.
portuguese: Estou a tentar evitar fritos.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Hoje estou a tentar comer de forma mais leve.
exampleSentences.english: Today I am trying to eat more lightly.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Which dessert is the least sweet?
portuguese: Qual é a sobremesa menos doce?
pronunciationNote: kwahl eh ah soh-breh-MEH-zah MEN-oosh DOH-s
notes: Useful if you do not like very sweet desserts.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Prefiro sobremesas menos doces.
exampleSentences.english: I prefer less sweet desserts.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Is the wine list long?
portuguese: A carta de vinhos é grande?
pronunciationNote: ah KAR-tah d VEE-nyoosh eh GRAN-d
notes: Useful if you want time to choose.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podia trazer a carta de vinhos?
exampleSentences.english: Could you bring the wine list?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you suggest a wine to go with the fish?
portuguese: Podia sugerir um vinho para acompanhar o peixe?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah soo-zheh-REER oom VEEN-yoo pah-rah ah-kohm-pah-NYAR oo PAY-sh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Que vinho combina melhor com este prato?
exampleSentences.english: Which wine goes best with this dish?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I would rather try a local white wine.
portuguese: Preferia provar um vinho branco da região.
pronunciationNote: preh-feh-REE-ah proh-VAR oom VEEN-yoo BRAN-koo dah reh-zhee-AWN
notes: Useful when choosing drinks in Portugal.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Gostava de provar um vinho da casa.
exampleSentences.english: I would like to try the house wine.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could we taste it before ordering a bottle?
portuguese: Podíamos prová-lo antes de pedir a garrafa?
pronunciationNote: poo-DEE-ah-moosh proh-VAH-loo AHN-tish dih peh-DEER ah gah-RAH-fah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Podíamos provar primeiro um copo?
exampleSentences.english: Could we try a glass first?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We are in no rush.
portuguese: Não temos pressa.
notes: Useful to slow down service politely.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não temos pressa, pode trazer depois.
exampleSentences.english: We are in no rush, you can bring it later.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We are a bit short on time.
portuguese: Estamos com pouco tempo.
notes: Useful if you need quick service.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Estamos com pouco tempo, o que sai mais depressa?
exampleSentences.english: We are short on time, what comes out fastest?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Which dishes come out quickly?
portuguese: Que pratos saem mais depressa?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Precisávamos de algo rápido.
exampleSentences.english: We needed something quick.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I am looking for somewhere less touristy to eat.
portuguese: Procuro um sítio menos turístico para comer.
notes: Useful outside the restaurant itself too.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Conhece algum sítio menos turístico por aqui?
exampleSentences.english: Do you know anywhere less touristy around here?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Do I need to book in advance?
portuguese: É preciso reservar com antecedência?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ao fim de semana é preciso reservar?
exampleSentences.english: At the weekend, do you need to book?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We are celebrating something special.
portuguese: Estamos a celebrar uma ocasião especial.
pronunciationNote: esh-TAH-moosh ah seh-leh-BRAR OO-mah oh-kah-ZYAWN esh-peh-see-AL

exampleSentences.portuguese: Estamos a celebrar um aniversário.
exampleSentences.english: We are celebrating a birthday.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you bring a candle with the dessert?
portuguese: Podia trazer uma vela com a sobremesa?
pronunciationNote: POH-dee-ah trah-ZAIR OO-mah VEH-lah kohng ah soh-breh-MEH-zah

exampleSentences.portuguese: É uma surpresa, por isso não diga nada.
exampleSentences.english: It is a surprise, so do not say anything.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you wrap this up to take away?
portuguese: Podia embrulhar isto para levar?

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sobrou comida, podia embrulhar para levar?
exampleSentences.english: There is food left over, could you wrap it up to take away?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could I have a box for the leftovers?
portuguese: Pode trazer uma caixa para as sobras?
pronunciationNote: POH-d trah-ZAIR OO-mah KAY-shah pah-rah az SOH-brash

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não queria desperdiçar isto.
exampleSentences.english: I did not want to waste this.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: The service has been excellent.
portuguese: O serviço tem sido excelente.

exampleSentences.portuguese: O serviço tem sido impecável desde que chegámos.
exampleSentences.english: The service has been excellent since we arrived.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: The food was good, but it took too long.
portuguese: A comida estava boa, mas demorou demasiado.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Gostámos da comida, mas o serviço foi lento.
exampleSentences.english: We liked the food, but the service was slow.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Would you say this portion is enough for one person?
portuguese: Diria que esta dose chega para uma pessoa?
pronunciationNote: dee-REE-ah keh ESH-tah DOH-zh SHEH-gah pah-rah OO-mah peh-SOH-ah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Esta dose costuma dar para duas pessoas?
exampleSentences.english: Is this portion usually enough for two people?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We are trying not to over-order.
portuguese: Estamos a tentar não pedir em excesso.
pronunciationNote: esh-TAH-moosh ah ten-TAR nawng peh-DEER ayn eh-SHEH-soo
notes: Useful when choosing for a group.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Queremos pedir o suficiente, mas sem exagerar.
exampleSentences.english: We want to order enough, but without overdoing it.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could you advise us on how many dishes to order?
portuguese: Pode aconselhar-nos sobre quantos pratos pedir?
pronunciationNote: POH-d ah-kohn-seh-LYAR-noosh SOH-br kwahn-toosh PRAH-toosh peh-DEER
notes: Good in tapas or sharing restaurants.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Somos quatro pessoas, quantos pratos recomenda?
exampleSentences.english: We are four people, how many dishes do you recommend?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: I would like to avoid anything too rich before travelling.
portuguese: Preferia evitar algo muito pesado antes de viajar.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes de viajar, prefiro comer coisas leves.
exampleSentences.english: Before travelling, I prefer to eat light things.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Is there a local market nearby where we can eat something simple?
portuguese: Há algum mercado aqui perto onde possamos comer qualquer coisa simples?
notes: Useful when asking locals for food advice.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Queríamos um sítio simples e bom para almoçar.
exampleSentences.english: We wanted a simple and good place for lunch.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Would you mind packing the sauce separately?
portuguese: Importa-se de embalar o molho à parte?
pronunciationNote: eem-POR-tah-sih d em-bah-LAR oo MOL-yoo ah PAR-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Importa-se de pôr os molhos em separado?
exampleSentences.english: Would you mind putting the sauces separately?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: We have already been waiting quite a while.
portuguese: Já estamos à espera há bastante tempo.
pronunciationNote: zhah esh-TAH-moosh ah ES-peh-rah ah bash-TAHN-t TEM-poo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Desculpe, já estamos à espera há quase meia hora.
exampleSentences.english: Sorry, we have already been waiting almost half an hour.

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Could someone come to take our order?
portuguese: Pode alguém vir tirar o nosso pedido?
pronunciationNote: POH-d al-GAYNG veer tee-RAR oo NOS-soo peh-DEE-doo
notes: Useful when staff have not returned.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando puder, pode vir levantar o pedido?
exampleSentences.english: When you can, could you come and take the order?

subject: Food, Cafes & Restaurants
english: Everything was delicious, we will definitely come back.
portuguese: Estava tudo delicioso, vamos voltar de certeza.
notes: Natural warm closing after a good meal.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Gostámos muito, havemos de voltar.
exampleSentences.english: We liked it a lot, we will come back.
